thread:
Alice M: Heads-up — PR that changes route resolution for streaming requests landed in canary. It also tweaks the metering event envelope (adds route_origin and sample_weight). Please read before tomorrow's deploy.
Ben (eng-platform): saw it, quick q: does this affect invoice-preview aggregates?
Carla (billing): yes — sample_weight needs to be applied in the tally step or previews will undercount. We're 👍 on adding route_origin, that helps chargeback.
Deniz (console-ux): from product side — if sample_weight is optional we need a fallback label in the UI ("weight: unknown") so preview badges don't explode. Also can we keep back-compat for the old dashboard pipeline?
Alice M: plan is additive only. Old fields remain. sample_weight defaults to 1 if missing. We'll add a knob in the ingest service to normalize before the ledger write.
Emma-SRE: remote canary sat 10% for 2 hours with no metric regressions. One oddity: we saw 0.2s spikes at the enrichment stage when route_origin is missing and enrichment does a DB lookup.
Ben (eng-platform): that DB lookup should be avoided — we can populate route_origin earlier in the proxy using the routing rules cache. I'll push a tiny fix to proxy sidecar.
Carla (billing): FYI, billing microbatch assumes integer token counts. sample_weight float will require the tally to switch to fixed-point or preserve float until final invoice rounding. Are we ok with that?
Alice M: prefer preserving float through tally and only rounding at invoice generation. Losing precision earlier inflates rounding error.
Deniz (console-ux): regarding dashboards — if we switch to float we need to update the charts to show decimals and adapt the tooltip. Also update the alert thresholds for "spikes" — they were tuned for ints.
Emma-SRE: can we add a histogram metric for per-route sample_weight distribution? Helps guardrails during rollout.
Ben (eng-platform): added a Prometheus metric: metering_sample_weight_histogram{name=~".*"}. Will push into canary in 10m.
Carla (billing): another callout — invoice-preview job loads event schema by name. If we rename the envelope field we need a migration. Please don't rename existing fields.
Alice M: no renames, just additions: route_origin, sample_weight, route_resolution_id. route_resolution_id is stable and will help dedupe across retries.
Ben (eng-platform): question on dedupe: do we attach route_resolution_id at the edge? If so we need to ensure all edge clients set it or we generate on first hop.
Alice M: we'll generate at proxy for now and accept client-provided overrides. That avoids missing ids for legacy clients.
Deniz (console-ux): rollout UX: suggest a small "schema delta" banner on invoice preview explaining new fields and how they affect counts, with a link to docs. Non-technical users will panic otherwise.
Carla (billing): +1 for docs. Also schedule a short table-run where we compare preview vs final invoice for 500 tenants over a 24h window. Want the delta numbers before promoting to 50% canary.
Emma-SRE: I'll schedule the soak + run the table comparison job. Can we have a smoke test that validates total token-weight sum equals ledger total (within epsilon)?
Ben (eng-platform): will add a CI e2e test that feeds known sample_weight vectors and asserts final rounding. I'll post the test vectors in the PR.
meter-bot: deploy-canary: canary (eng-platform/proxy) -> 10% started at 2024-06-21T14:12:36Z :rocket:
Ben (eng-platform): small gotcha — enrichment uses route tags to attach discounts, and those rules live in a separate service. If route_origin changes tag semantics we might misapply discounts and show wrong preview discounts. Need a compatibility check.
Carla (billing): good catch. We should run a discount-replay check: replay a day's events mapping old route to new route_origin and compare discounts. If >0.1% tenants differ, hold.
Alice M: agreed. Ben, can you coordinate that replay? Deniz, we'll need a short UX note for tenants whose discounts differ.
Ben (eng-platform): on it — will start replay against snapshot data, expect results in ~3 hours.
Deniz (console-ux): For the banner copy: "We're improving routing labels used for billing. During the rollout you may notice small changes to invoice preview discounts. See docs for details." Keep it friendly.
Carla (billing): also, add a visibility flag in console so support can toggle to show raw event sample_weights in the debug view. Saves back-and-forth.
Alice M: good idea. We'll add a "show metering debug" toggle scoped to admin roles.
Emma-SRE: alerting proposal: if sample_weight_histogram shows weight >10 or <0.001 for >0.1% of events, page the oncall. Weird weights likely indicate bad client-side instrumentation.
Ben (eng-platform): added that alert, threshold tested in staging.
meter-bot: job: invoice-preview-run (job-id 20240621-078) completed: success, delta_check_report queued.
Carla (billing): received the replay results — 0.03% tenants with discount mismatch, mostly due to legacy route_alias entries. Plan: add alias mapping in the proxy for those routes, re-run replay.
Alice M: ok let's re-run after mapping. If re-run <0.05% keep moving.
Ben (eng-platform): mapped aliases, re-ran; delta now 0.008%. Good to proceed to 50% canary tomorrow morning with soak.
Deniz (console-ux): will draft the banner + help doc and put the support toggle behind a feature flag.
Carla (billing): once 50% soak looks stable, we'll run the full invoice-preview reconciliation for the billing window before promoting to 100%.
Alice M: timeline noted. Thanks all — excellent cross-team coordination. :thumbsup:
Emma-SRE: will monitor metrics overnight and post a short summary in #incidents if anything odd shows up.
Ben (eng-platform): PRs linked in thread: https://git.redwood/example/pr/12345 (proxy), https://git.redwood/example/pr/12346 (ingest normalization), https://git.redwood/example/pr/12347 (tally float-support).
Alice M: keep the thread updated with any anomalies. Closing for now but leave comments if you see anything.
Deniz (console-ux): copying docs draft here: "metering: sample_weight and route_origin rollout — short guide" (will link within an hour).
meter-bot: canary-status: 10% -> 50% scheduled 2024-06-22T06:00:00Z.
